messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Kim <daniel.kim@fleetly.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 09:12:03 -0700
Subject: Fleetly — quick intake: use case, volume, timeline, and demo slots

Hi Daniel —

Thanks for signing up and trying Redwood — I saw Fleetly create a self-serve account this morning. Before we lock a demo, two quick things so we tailor the session: 1) primary use case (RAG, embeddings search, classification, etc.), 2) expected monthly requests and peak concurrency, 3) typical prompt/context length (avg tokens or sequence length), and 4) target timeline to pilot/production.

If everything looks aligned we can run a short technical demo (25–30 minutes) with my colleague Marissa (solutions engineer). I have three windows available next week — pick one that works or propose alternatives:

- Tue 24 Aug — 10:00–10:30 PT
- Wed 25 Aug — 14:00–14:30 PT
- Thu 26 Aug — 09:00–09:30 PT

I’m attaching a brief demo deck and a tiny intake template you can drop a sample of your traffic into.

Attachments: redwood-demo-deck.pdf (overview), fleetly_sample_traffic.csv (sample schema)

Quick ask: could you paste a 1–2 line example of a typical user query? That helps us prep the demo prompts.

Thanks —
Tessa Morgan
Senior SDR, Redwood Inference
T: (415) 555-0132
From: Daniel Kim <daniel.kim@fleetly.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 12:05:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Fleetly — quick intake: use case, volume, timeline, and demo slots

Hi Tessa —

Appreciate the quick outreach. A bit about us: we’re building an in-app assistant + search for operators that surfaces policy and incident notes. Primary use case will be RAG (embeddings + retrieval) and some short-form generation for message drafts.

Estimated volume: ~200k retrieval requests/month initially with spikes up to ~40 QPS during batch processing windows. Typical request payloads are small — user query + context ids; average sequence length ~ 150–400 tokens.

Target timeline: pilot in ~10–12 weeks with production rollout in Q1 2027. Must support SSO (SAML) and prefer US data residency (US-East).

I attached a CSV with hourly traffic samples and a couple of representative queries.

Attachments: fleetly_sample_traffic.csv, sample_queries.csv

Regarding slots: Tue 24 at 10:00 PT works for me. Can you send a calendar invite?

Thanks,
Daniel Kim
Head of Platform — Fleetly
daniel.kim@fleetly.com | +1 650-555-2290

Pre-demo checklist for us (quick):
- Confirm SSO requirement (SAML provider + contact)
- Any data residency certifications needed (SOC2, HIPAA, etc.)
- If you can, paste 2–3 representative queries into the sample_queries.csv column marked EXAMPLE

I attached the demo deck again and added the HubSpot lead for tracking.

Calendar: https://calendar.redwood.com/booking?slot=2026-08-24T10:00-07:00

See you Tue —
Tessa
